narrative:
Ross County has 44,901 registered voters, with 15.5% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 24.9% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 52.7%, a pronounced Democratic lean of 27.8 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 28.8% of registrants.
